behavior: Walks and stalks on the ground, probing soil and vegetation for insects; males sing from exposed perches and defend breeding territories with postures and flight displays. Often forms loose flocks outside the breeding season.
field_marks: Bright yellow throat and underparts crossed by a bold black V
Heavily streaked brown-and-black back and rounded wings
Striped crown with a yellow eyebrow and pale moustachial line
Long, straight, spear-shaped gray bill and dark brown eye
Long pale pinkish-gray legs with sturdy toes
Short barred brown tail with conspicuous white outer feathers
habitat: Native grasslands, prairies, pastures, hayfields, wet meadows, agricultural fields, savannas, and other open grassy areas; nests on the ground in dense vegetation.
